verdict.rationale: vLLM ships a documented OpenAI-compatible API server plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support, with community confirmation that the OpenAI-compatible API works well for integration into existing tooling. This provides a clear, documented public API surface for programmatic/agentic use. Missing for 10: no dedicated llms.txt or machine-readable API spec artifact (404 on probe), and no independent hands-on API-integration writeup beyond forum comments.
